About five Russian warplanes entered South Korea's air defence zone on 24 November and approached Ulleung Island; Seoul issued its first preliminary air alert over Russian aircraft and summoned Russia's attaché.

NATO agreed on 23 November to give Poland an early-warning aircraft after Russian missiles fell on its territory; a Russian drone entered Polish airspace again late on 23 November, which Warsaw called deliberate.
The US added Megaspeed and six other Southeast Asian firms to its Entity List on 23 November over suspected diversion of Nvidia chips to China.
US authorities are investigating suspected cyberattacks on as many as 50 tankers, with Iran the primary suspect, the Wall Street Journal reported on 23 November.

Drones struck the Russian corvette Merkury at Benghazi, Libya, on 22 November in an attack Ukraine claims; satellite imagery shows it capsized, and Libya's eastern government asked for a UN investigation.
Russia summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires on 23 November over the 1 December border closure, warning of "the brink of an open war".
Iran said on 23 November it will use "all available means" against the US blockade and could reopen Hormuz within two days if hostilities, the blockade and sanctions end.
